unregistered
column2: or the VCPUs are cleaned up

column2: the get_user_pages() is invoked on the specific memory are of the

we explicitly find the head page of the compound page before calling
put_page() on it.
At least with the latest kernel
column2: this is not correct.  put_page() already

column1: handles finding the correct head page of a compound
various counts on the individual tail page which are important for
transparent huge pages.  We don't support transparent hugepages on Power
